title: Gate VKS cluster creation on Supervisor namespace readiness
prompt:
Implement the production code in src/VcfVksProvisioning.psm1. The public New-VcfVksCluster advanced function must use the installed VMware.Sdk.Vcf.SddcManager PowerCLI SDK for VCF inventory discovery, precheck both the vSphere Supervisor and its namespace through the exact REST contract in docs/contract.json, and create a VKS Cluster through the Supervisor Kubernetes API only when both prechecks pass. Do not vendor, copy, replace, or fake any VMware.Sdk.Vcf module. Preserve the module manifest's RequiredModules dependency.

The function must support an Inventory parameter set (-VcfServer and -VCenterFqdn) that resolves the vCenter endpoint with Invoke-VcfGetVcenters, plus a Direct parameter set (-VCenterUri) used by the isolated verifier. Both sets also require -SupervisorId, -Namespace, -Name, -ClusterClass, -KubernetesVersion, -VmClass, -StorageClass, -VCenterSessionId, and -KubeBearerToken. Support optional -ControlPlaneReplicas, -WorkerReplicas, -PodCidrBlocks, -ServiceCidrBlocks, and -ServiceDomain values.

Follow docs/contract.json exactly. Send the vCenter session in vmware-api-session-id. First query the Supervisor summary and require config_status RUNNING, kubernetes_status READY, and a usable apiendpoint. Then query the namespace V2 instance and require config_status RUNNING and an exact supervisor match. If either request fails or either state check fails, throw before any mutating request. Only after the gate passes, POST a cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta2 Cluster to the namespaced Kubernetes collection under the returned apiendpoint, authenticating with the Kubernetes bearer token. Use topology variables named vmClass and storageClass. Optional request properties must be absent when their parameters are unset; never serialize them as null, empty strings, empty arrays, or empty objects. Explicitly supplied empty optional values must be rejected.

The module must honor -WhatIf for the POST and return the decoded Kubernetes response on success. Keep all network access injectable through the documented Direct parameter set; the verifier contacts only the loopback mock and never a VMware endpoint. Do not edit docs/contract.json, docs/official_sources.json, mock/mock_server.py, or tests/verify.py. Run python3 tests/verify.py from the repository root.
